description.value: Mikado Sushi is a Japanese sushi restaurant in Princeton, BC, serving an extensive menu of rolls, nigiri, sashimi, tempura, and appetizers made with locally sourced ingredients including sockeye salmon and albacore tuna. The restaurant is currently operating take-out only, making it a practical stop for cyclists passing through town who want a quick, quality meal to go. Princeton sits along popular cycling routes in the Similkameen Valley, and Mikado's diverse menu includes options for a range of dietary needs.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Mikado Sushi is an active Japanese sushi restaurant at 130 Bridge Street, Princeton, BC, operating take-out only as of an August 2, 2024 notice ('Our dining room is temporarily unavailable until the further notice'). The menu explicitly labels many items as 'Vegetarian' and 'Gluten free,' confirming dietary options. No bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM opening hours (Mo-Fr 11:00-19:00) differ slightly from website hours (Monday–Friday 11:30 am–7 pm); website should be treated as authoritative.
Dining room is listed as 'temporarily unavailable' with no confirmed resumption date; take-out only status may be long-term.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active business with a current website, confirmed address, and a recent (August 2024) operational notice. Useful take-out stop for touring cyclists in Princeton.

Takeout.detail: Website front page and a dedicated notice post state 'Take-out Only — Our dining room is temporarily unavailable until the further notice.'
